'''Keenos''' was an [[entertainer]] residing in [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. He entertained crowds in the [[Atrium]] by juggling [[Club/Legends|clubs]] lit on fire while reciting stanzas of the poem "[[The Dread Pirate Kragg]]." Keenos would often pass around a hat after his performances, asking for donations to the [[Old Spacers' Entertainment Hospice]] which consisted mostly of himself. A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer, Keenos would help Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] whenever possible.<ref name="Game" />
